title: Cicada 3301 (2012) — US physical QR poster locations, historical seed
rightsDecision: Published historical coordinates and solver-documented outcomes from cited public sources only. The posters are ephemeral 2012 artifacts and are long gone; this pack documents history and must not be read as 'something is there now'. No puzzle material, QR payloads, or onion addresses are reproduced.
seedNote: Created 2026-10-23 (backlog T12.1). US subset (8 of the 14 coordinates published 2012-01-09) for the historical-network viewer; the full global list is tabulated in docs/cicada-3301-qr-locations-2026-10-23.md.
